brief: Premium yoga and studio-to-street apparel. $80-130 per piece. Celebrity-adjacent aesthetic, so we want shoppers who care about brand and wellness.

profile.business_summary: Premium yoga and studio-to-street apparel brand featuring a celebrity-adjacent aesthetic, targeting brand-conscious and wellness-focused shoppers with products priced between $80 and $130 per piece.

relevant_tags.why: Core product category is yoga apparel.
Core product category is activewear/studio-to-street apparel.
The brand targets shoppers who care about wellness.
Studio-to-street apparel is adjacent to casual wear.
Shoppers taking fitness classes are highly likely to purchase premium yoga apparel.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Advertiser claims a 'celebrity-adjacent aesthetic' which strongly aligns with influencer positioning.

persona_conflicts.conflict: disinterested_in: luxury-only messaging, vague premium positioning
persona_conflicts.evidence: Advertiser positions itself as premium ($80-130 per piece) with a celebrity-adjacent aesthetic.

note_signals.why: Movewell has fitness-engaged shoppers with strong crossover in wellness and beauty, matching the target audience perfectly.
Studiogrid users are actively spending on self-care and fitness, making them prime candidates for premium yoga wear.
Linden Park has a conservative brand sensibility, which conflicts with the advertiser's celebrity-adjacent aesthetic.
Velvetline features a minimalist aesthetic and identity-driven purchasing, aligning well with brand-conscious, celebrity-adjacent shoppers.

profile.gate_reason: The product, price point, and target audience are clearly defined, allowing for immediate planning and matching.
clarifying_questions: Is your apparel line designed primarily for women, or do you offer unisex/men's collections as well?
Are there any specific material or sustainability claims (e.g., organic, recycled) that we should highlight in the creatives?
